title: Awadb Vector Store
markdown: 如果您在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 ``` %pip install llama-index-embeddings-huggingface %pip install llama-index-vector-stores-awadb ``` ``` !pip install llama-index ``` ## 建立 Awadb index ``` import logging import sys logging.basicConfig(stream=sys.stdout, level=logging.INFO) logging.getLogger().addHandler(logging.StreamHandler(stream=sys.stdout)) ``` #### 載入 documents，建置 VectorStoreIndex ``` from llama_index.core import ( SimpleDirectoryReader, VectorStoreIndex, StorageContext, ) from IPython.display import Markdown, display import openai openai.api_key = "" ``` ``` INFO:numexpr.utils:Note: NumExpr detected 12 cores but "NUMEXPR_MAX_THREADS" not set, so enforcing safe limit of 8. Note: NumExpr detected 12 cores but "NUMEXPR_MAX_THREADS" not set, so enforcing safe limit of 8. INFO:numexpr.utils:NumExpr defaulting to 8 threads. NumExpr defaulting to 8 threads. ``` #### 下載資料 ``` !mkdir -p 'data/paul_graham/' !wget 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/run-llama/llama_index/main/docs/examples/data/paul_graham/paul_graham_essay.txt' -O 'data/paul_graham/paul_graham_essay.txt' ``` #### 載入資料 ``` # load documents documents = SimpleDirectoryReader("./data/paul_graham/").load_data() ``` ``` from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding from llama_index.vector_stores.awadb import AwaDBVectorStore embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5") vector_store = AwaDBVectorStore() storage_context = StorageContext.from_defaults(vector_store=vector_store) index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents( documents, storage_context=storage_context, embed_model=embed_model ) ``` #### 查詢 Index ``` # set Logging to DEBUG for more detailed outputs query_engine = index.as_query_engine() response = query_engine.query("What did the author do growing up?") ``` ``` display(Markdown(f"{response}")) ``` **成長過程中，作者寫短篇故事，在 IBM 1401 上進行程式設計實驗，催促父親購買 TRS-80 電腦，寫簡單的遊戲，一個預測他的模型火箭飛得有多高程式，以及一個文字處理器。他在大學期間也研究了哲學，轉向 AI，並參與了網際網路基礎設施的建置。他寫了文章並在網路上發表，每週四晚上與一群朋友共進晚餐，畫畫，並在劍橋買了一棟房子。** ``` # set Logging to DEBUG for more detailed outputs query_engine = index.as_query_engine() response = query_engine.query( "What did the author do after his time at Y Combinator?" ) ``` ``` display(Markdown(f"{response}")) ``` **在 Y Combinator 的期間，作者寫了文章，研究了 Lisp，並畫畫。他也去俄勒岡探望母親，並幫助她離開了養老院。**
